Ebibuuzo ebi n'eby'okureeberaho by'okutooranamo (n'ebigaruzo).

Omu n’ekibiina ky’abegyesa omu mashomero g’abaana abato nibaija kwetegereza omu mbeera za butoosha omugasho ogurikukurataho kuruga omu mutwe gw’okucweekereza eby’obutonde: “Kugamba aha bintu bikuru ebiri omu by’obutonde ebi barikucweekereza, nk’emibala, oburungo, obunene, obushushu n’ebindi.” Ni mbeera ki ey’abaana erikworeka ngu omugasho ogwo gutungwa?

A. Omuhinguzi Santiago naabaasa kuta omwanya gw'okwega, naashushaniisa amabaare g'obunene obutari bumwe.
B. Omuhimbo gw'emisana, Pablo areeba ekijiiko kandi yaareeba omushusho gwe naagira ati: "Reeba, Pablo!"
C. Omu María omu kubanzaara, akoraaniza amataare g'emiti agari mushushani omu kashaaho.
D. Omuhanda gw'okubungana omu rurembo, Soledad naaza aha mbuto omu mikono ye, yaagira ati: "Eziruma"

**D**

Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omubanza ari kukora omurimo gw'ekibina gw'okukora aha bu умеgyezi bw'okucungura hamwe n'ekigyendererwa ky'eklassi: "Kumanya eby'okukozesa n'omurimo gwabyo." A. Omu omutabo ogurikugamba aha mitero y’ebibala, shaza eby’okugarukamu by’ebibuuzo ebirikubaasa kugarukwamu turikukoresa ebigyirizo: Ni kibala ki ekya ranga ya yellow? Ni kibala ki ekirikukoma? Ni kibala ki ekirikukwata kubi? Ni kibala ki ekirikunuunuuka gye?
B. Omu rupapura orukubairemu emiringo erikubaasa kworekwa n'obumwe aha bw'obwengye (oburungi/obukali, oburagwa/omuchungwa, obworobi/obukomeezi, omunungo murungi/omunungo mubi), taangira ebijanjaara omu muringo egirikukuratira embeera ezi.
C. Omu rupapura orukukwata aha mukoro ogurikworeka buri kamwe aha bwengye, shaza eby’okugarukamu by’ebibuuzo ebi: Ni bwengye ki obu orikukoresa kwetegyereza ngu ekitookye ni kiragura? Ni bwengye ki obu orikukoresa kwetegyereza ngu epere ni nshumiire? Ni bwengye ki obu orikukoresa kwetegyereza ngu ekishishwa ky’ekitookye ni kirerere? Ni bwengye ki obu orikukoresa kwetegyereza ngu omucungwa ni guhumba?
D. Omu mweshomi ogurikworeka ebishushani by'ebijuma ebi, harimu emisingi erikukurira, ogumu gurimu akamwenyu n'ogundi gurimu obusaasi, shushani eby'okugarukamu byaawe aha bibuuzo ebi: Ku waaba noorya akacweka k'omucungwa, okahurira omuhindo gw'okushemererwa rundi ogw'obusaasi? Ku waaba nooreeba ibara ry'entege, okarikunda rundi torikukunda? Ku waaba nookora aha kikoba ky'epere, okahurira omuhindo gw'okushemererwa rundi ogw'obusaasi? Ku waaba noohumurira omucungwa, okagukunda rundi torikukunda?

**C**

Omwegyesereza omwegyesi, omugyezibwa naayenda kworeka abegi emiringo etari emwe ey'okwaanya ebintu ebikwatiraine. Ahabw'ekyo, ayorekire abegi be ecupa erimu amaizi, amabaare, amajuta, n'omunyo. Omugyezibwa aine ecupa nyingi ezitebeekanisiibwe n'ebintu ebi bimwe. Aha mirimo ei erikukurataho, niki ekira kuleetera abegi kwega aha miringo y'okwaanya ebintu ebikwatiraine, kandi nabo nibakuzya obwengye bwabo omu kucungura obuhame bw'ebirikuruga omu kunoonyereza kw'obwomeezi?

A. Omu mirwi, nibasharamu omuringo ogurikukiraho kubasa kw'ahukanisa emicwe n'obwo babihurikize ekyabaretere kwikiriza batyo.
B. Omu omwe omwe, nibataana omutaano kurugiirira omu muringo gwona ogubasa kuba gubaire gusaaniire, kandi bashwijuma obwingana bw'okubaasa kukikora.
C. Omwe-omwe, nibaha ebi barikuteekateeka aha muringo ogu bateekwa kukuratira, bagira omuringo ogw'omukago, reero bagutandika kukora.
D. Omwe-omwe, nibakurata omuringo ogworekwa omwegyesa kw'ahukanisa emicwe n'okumanya oburyo bw'okwahukanisa obukozesibwe omuri buri omwe.

**B**

Garukamu ekibuuzo eki ekihikire orikukurata empandiika emwe:
Omwegyesereza ari kukora aha mutwe gw'omubiri gw'omuntu omu kiraasi ey'abana, kandi nayegyesa ekigyendererwa ky'okwetegyereza omukoro gw'omutima. Obu arikubuuza abeeshuri ebi barikumanya, naamanya ngu abamwe baine enshobyo aha mutwe ogwo. Omu bintu ebi birikukurataho, niki ekirikwohereza enshobyo aha mutima?

A. Omutima gukomera kurabira omu mizano.
B. Omutima gw'omuntu guringana n'enkumu ye.
C. Omutima nigwija kureetera eshagama kutwara omwaka omu mubiri.
D. Omutima nigwo gukora eshagazi erikugenda omu mubiri gwona.

**D**

### **Ebibuuzo n'Eby'okugarukamu**

**1. Ekibiina ky’abegyesa omu mashomero g’abaana abato nibenda kwetegyereza omugasho ogu kuruga omu mutwe gw’okucweekereza eby’obutonde: “Kugamba aha bintu bikuru ebiri omu by’obutonde ebi barikucweekereza, nk’emibala, oburungo, obunene, n'emishusho.” Ni mbeera ki ey’abaana erikworeka ngu omugasho ogwo gutungirwe?**

A. Omu mwanya gw'okwega, Santiago naashushaniisa amabaare g'obunene obutari bumwe.

B. Omu kuhuumura kw'emisana, Pablo areeba ekijiiko, yaareeba omushusho gwe, yaagira ati: "Reeba, niinye Pablo!"

C. María omu kubanzaara, akoraaniza amataagi g'emiti agari omu mushusho gumwe omu kashaaho.

D. Omu kubungana omu rurembo, Soledad akwata embuto omu ngaro ze, yaagira ati: "Ezi zine amahwa!"

**Eky'okugarukamu ekihikire: D**
*(Obushobanuzi: Soledad nakoresa ebigambo ("Ezine amahwa!") kushoboorora oburungo bw'ekintu ky'obutonde, ekirikuhikaana n'ekigyendererwa ky'okugamba aha bintu bikuru by'ebintu ebi barikucweekereza.)*

---

**2. Omwegyesa w'ekibiina ky'abato ari kukora omurimo gw'okumanyisa abegi aha bintu n'emiringo yaabyo. Ekigyendererwa ni: "Kumanya ebikoreso n'emigasho yaabyo." Okutandika, aheereza ekibiina omunana, omucungwa, n'epfeere, yaabagambira kubihumurira, kubireeba, kubikwataho, n'okubirya. N'omurimo ki ogu omwegyesa arikubaasa kuteekaho okuhwera abegyeswa kutunga ekigyendererwa ekyagambirweho?**

A. Kubabuuza ebibuuzo nka: Ni kibala ki ekya rangi ya kyenvu? Ni kibala ki ekigumire? Ni kibala ki ekirikunuunuka gye?

B. Kuha abegi orupapura orine emiringo (nka: ekirikutaryama/ekirikushaarira, ekyenvu/icungwa, ekyorobi/ekigumire, ekirikutunuunuka gye/kubi) ngu bataanise ebibala ebyo.

C. Kuha abegi orupapura orurikukwata aha bwengye butaano, ngu bagarukemu ebibuuzo nka: Ni bwengye ki obu orikukoresa kumanya ngu omunana guri ekyenvu? Ni bwengye ki obu orikukoresa kumanya ngu epfeere neeryama? Ni bwengye ki obu orikukoresa kumanya ngu ekishushu ky'omunana kyorebire? Ni bwengye ki obu orikukoresa kumanya ngu omucungwa niguhumba gye?

D. Kuha abegi orupapura orine ebishushani by'ebibala n'obumwenyu obushemereirwe n'obunakuviire, ngu booreke ebi barikukunda n'ebi batarikukunda aha kibala kimwe kimwe.

**Eky'okugarukamu ekihikire: C**
*(Obushobanuzi: Omurimo ogu niguhwera abaana kwetegyereza ngu nibakoresa obwengye bwabo butaano (okureeba, okuhurira, okuhumurira, okukwataho, n'okurya) kumanya emiringo y'ebintu, ekirikuhikaana n'ekigyendererwa.)*

---

**3. Omwegyesa naayenda kworeka abegi emiringo etari emwe ey'okwahukanisa ebintu ebitabuukiraine. Ahabw'ekyo, aboreka ecupa erimu amaizi, amabaare, amajuta, n'omwonyo. Omwegyesa aine ecupa nyingi ezirimu ebintu nk'ebyo. Aha mirimo ei, n'omurimo ki ogurikubaasa kuhwera abegi kwega aha miringo y'okwahukanisa ebintu, kandi omu bwire bumwe nibakula omu bwengye bw'okushoboorora ebi barikutoorana omu kucweekereza kwabo?**

A. Omu bibiina, nibasharamu omuringo ogubakizireyo kugira gubasobozese okwahukanisa ebintu ebyo, kandi nibashoboorora ahabw'enki nibateekateeka batyo.

B. Buri omwe, naayeshera omuringo gwona ogu arikuteekateeka ngu nigubaasa kukora, reero yaashwijuma yaareeba yaaba gukozire gye.

C. Buri omwe, naagamba eki arikuteekateeka aha muringo ogu bateekwa kukuratira, reero bakatooranaho omuringo gumwe gw'okukoresa boona.

D. Buri omwe, naakurata omuringo ogu omwegyesa aboreka okwahukanisa ebintu ebyo, reero yaamanyisibwa oburyo obukozesibwe.

**Eky'okugarukamu ekihikire: A**
*(Obushobanuzi: Okukora omu bibiina n'okushoboorora ahabw'enki batooraine omuringo ogwo nikiha abegi omugisha gw'okuteekateeka nka basayansi, okucacana, n'okushoboorora ebi barikwikiririzaamu, ekirikukomeza obwengye bwabo.)*

A. Ahabw'okuba okuhindura nyukiriya y'akatafaari k'omubiri kuba ekiramu kihikire, akatafaari akarikwakiira nyukiriya kashemereire kuba katarakora omurimo gw'omutaano kandi karimu ebintu ebirikubaasa kugarura nyukiriya omu mbeera y'obutandikiro.

B. Ahabw'okuba eigi n'akatafaari akatarakora omurimo gw'omutaano, akarikubaasa kureeta obutafaari bw'emiringo mingi. Kandi, saayitoopurazima yaako erimu ebintu ebirikutandika omurimo gw'okugarura nyukiriya omu mbeera y'obutandikiro.

C. Ahabw'okuba obutafaari obundi bw'omubiri, nk'obw'omu nda, buba bwine ebintu ebirikuzibira okukura kw'omwana omuhango, ekitarikubaho omu katafaari k'eigi.

D. Ahabw'okuba saayitoopurazima y'akatafaari k'eigi, okutashushana n'ey'obutafaari obundi bw'omubiri, eine ebintu byona ebirikwetengwa okugarura nyukiriya y'akatafaari akakuzire omu mbeera y'obutandikiro, ekirikuhwera okutandika okukura kw'ekiramu kisya.

**D**

Ebibuuzo ebi n'eby'okureeberaho by'okutooranamo (n'ebigaruzo).

Omu n’ekibiina ky’abegyesa omu mashomero g’abaana abato nibaija kwetegereza omu mbeera za butoosha omugasho ogurikukurataho kuruga omu mutwe gw’okucweekereza eby’obutonde: “Kugamba aha bintu bikuru ebiri omu by’obutonde ebi barikucweekereza, nk’emibala, oburungo, obunene, obushushu n’ebindi.” Ni mbeera ki ey’abaana erikworeka ngu omugasho ogwo gutungwa?

A. Omuhinguzi Santiago naabaasa kuta omwanya gw'okwega, naashushaniisa amabaare g'obunene obutari bumwe.

B. Omuhimbo gw'emisana, Pablo areeba ekijiiko kandi yaareeba omushusho gwe naagira ati: "Reeba, Pablo!"

C. Omu María omu kubanzaara, akoraaniza amataare g'emiti agari mushushani omu kashaaho.

D. Omuhanda gw'okubungana omu rurembo, Soledad naaza aha mbuto omu mikono ye, yaagira ati: "Eziruma"

**D**

Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omubanza ari kukora omurimo gw'ekibina gw'okukora aha bu умеgyezi bw'okucungura hamwe n'ekigyendererwa ky'eklassi: "Kumanya eby'okukozesa n'omurimo gwabyo." Okutandika omurimo, naija kuha ekiina kyona omunana, orungyebwa, n'eppere, kandi naija kubagambira kunuunuza, kureeba, kukwata, n'okureeba buri kibala. Twahiriza aha mbeera eri ahaiguru, omurimo gwaha ogu omwegyesa arikubaasa kuteekamu okukuraho abegyeswa bagonde ekigyendererwa ekyagambirweho?

A. Omu omutabo ogurikugamba aha mitero y’ebibala, shaza eby’okugarukamu by’ebibuuzo ebirikubaasa kugarukwamu turikukoresa ebigyirizo: Ni kibala ki ekya ranga ya yellow? Ni kibala ki ekirikukoma? Ni kibala ki ekirikukwata kubi? Ni kibala ki ekirikunuunuuka gye?

B. Omu rupapura orukubairemu emiringo erikubaasa kworekwa n'obumwe aha bw'obwengye (oburungi/obukali, oburagwa/omuchungwa, obworobi/obukomeezi, omunungo murungi/omunungo mubi), taangira ebijanjaara omu muringo egirikukuratira embeera ezi.

C. Omu rupapura orukukwata aha mukoro ogurikworeka buri kamwe aha bwengye, shaza eby’okugarukamu by’ebibuuzo ebi: Ni bwengye ki obu orikukoresa kwetegyereza ngu ekitookye ni kiragura? D. **C**

A. Omu mirwi, nibasharamu omuringo ogurikukiraho kubasa kw'ahukanisa emicwe n'obwo babihurikize ekyabaretere kwikiriza batyo.

**B**

A. Ogyira omugo gw’omunyeeto aha kashereti kandi amworekye ngu, arikucungura omugo kuruga aha muheru gw’akashereti, nigutunga omugisha gw’okucunguruka omu muringo gw’ekizingo. **C**

### **Ebibuuzo n'Eby'okutooranomu (N'ebigaruzo)**

**Ekibuuzo 1**

Ekibiina ky'abegyesa b'omu mashomero g'abaana abato nikiija kwetegyereza omu mbeera za butoosha, okuhikiirizibwa kw'omugasho ogurikukurataho kuruga omu mutwe gw'okucweeka eby'obutonde: “Okugamba aha bikuru ebiri omu bintu by'obutonde ebi barikucweeka, nk'amabara, ebishushani, obunene, obukwatsi n'ebindi.” N'embeera ki ey'omwana erikworeka ngu omugasho ogwo gwahikiirizibwa?

A. Omu mwanya gw'okuzaana, Santiago naatebeekanisa amabaare g'obunene obutari bumwe.

B. Omu kucwa kw'emisana, Pablo naareeba ekijiiko, yaareebamu ekishushani kye, yaagira ati: "Reeba, ni Pablo!"

C. Omu kuzaana, María naakoraaniza amababi g'emiti agafaanana omu kashaaho.

D. Omu kubungira omu rurembo, Soledad naakwata embuto omu ngaro ze, yaagira ati: "Ezi nizaruma."

**Eky'okugarukamu ekihikire: D**

---

**Ekibuuzo 2**

Omwegyesa w'omwaka gw'okubanza naakora omurimo n'ekibiina aha bwengye bw'okwetegyereza, aine ekigyendererwa eki: “Okumanya obwengye n'emirimo yabwo.” Okutandika, aha buri kibiina ekitookye, omuhenda, n'epeera, kandi abagambira kuhumuriza, kureeba, kukwataho, n'okuryaho buri kibala. Kurugiirira aha mbeera egi, n'omurimo ki ogu omwegyesa arikubaasa kuteekaho kugira ngu abayegi bahikiirize ekigyendererwa ekyagambirweho?

A. Omu katabo akarikugamba aha mize y'ebibala, baataho eby'okugarukamu barikukoresa ebirabiko: Ni kibala ki ekya ranga ya yero? Ni kibala ki ekigumire? Ni kibala ki ekirikukwataho kigira amashushu? Ni kibala ki ekirikutuunga gye?

B. Aha rupapura orurimu emiringo erikworeka obwengye (okuryohera/okushaarira, oburaira/oburinga, okworoba/okuguma, akatuungo karungi/akatuungo kabi), baataho ebirabiko by'ebibala kurugiirira aha mize yaabyo.

C. Aha rupapura aharikworeka buri kamwe aha bwengye, garukamu ebibuuzo ebi: Ni bwengye ki obu orikukoresa kumanya ngu ekitookye ni kiraira? Ni bwengye ki obu orikukoresa kumanya ngu epeera neeryohera? Ni bwengye ki obu orikukoresa kumanya ngu ekishushu ky'ekitookye nikyereera? Ni bwengye ki obu orikukoresa kumanya ngu omuhenda nigutuunga?

D. Aha rupapura aharikworeka ebishushani by'ebibala ebi, harimu ebishushani by'okumwenya n'eby'obusaasi, shushanya eby'okugarukamu byawe aha bibuuzo ebi: Ku orikurya akacweka k'omuhenda, noohurira okushemererwa nari obusaasi? Ku orikureeba ibara ry'ekitookye, noryenda nari torikwenda? Ku orikukwata aha kishushu ky'epeera, noohurira okushemererwa nari obusaasi? Ku orikuhumuriza omuhenda, n'ogukunda nari torikukunda?

**Eky'okugarukamu ekihikire: C**

**Ekibuuzo 3**

Omwegyesa naayenda kworeka abayegi emiringo etari emwe ey'okwahukanisa ebintu ebitabikaine. N'ahabw'ekyo, aboreka ecupa erimu amaizi, amabaare, amagita, n'omwonyo. Omwegyesa aine ecupa nyingi ezitebeekanisiibwe n'ebintu ebi bimwe. Aha mirimo erikukurataho, n'omurimo ki ogurikuza kureetera abayegi kwega aha miringo y'okwahukanisa ebitabikaine, kandi obwo barikukulaakulanya obwengye bwabo bw'okushoboorora ebirikuruga omu kunoonyereza kwabo?

A. Omu bibiina, nibatooranomu omuringo ogusingayo g'okwahukanisa ebintu ebyo kandi baashoboorora ekyabareeteire kukitooranomu.

B. Buri omwe, naatunga omuringo gwe gw'okukikora kurugiirira aha ki arikuteekateeka ngu nikibaasa kukora, reero yaashwijuma yaareeba yaaba buzima nikibaasika.

C. Buri omwe, naagamba eki arikuteekateeka aha muringo ogu bateekwa kukuratira, baakwatanisa ebi baateekateekire, reero baatandika kukora.

D. Buri omwe, naakurata omuringo ogu omwegyesa abahaire gw'okwahukanisa ebintu ebyo, reero yaamanyisa oburyo obukoresiibwe aha buri kintu.
